-- Diagnóstico: tolerância absoluta de 1e-9 somente para representação DOUBLE.
-- Qualquer linha contada impede publicar a transformação.
SELECT count(*)
FROM raw.orders
WHERE NOT isfinite(total)
   OR total < 0
   OR try_cast(total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) IS NULL
   OR abs(total - CAST(try_cast(total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS DOUBLE)) > 1e-9;
SELECT count(*) FROM raw.orders WHERE nItems <= 0

-- Diagnóstico: preço textual com até duas casas, sem arredondamento tolerado.
SELECT count(*)
FROM raw.products
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match(Price, '[0-9]+([.][0-9]{1,2})?')
   OR try_cast(Price AS DECIMAL(18,2)) IS NULL;

SELECT count(*) FROM raw.products
            WHERE Size NOT IN ('Small','Medium','Large','Extra Large')
               OR Category NOT IN ('Classic','Specialty','Vegetarian')

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT Name FROM raw.products GROUP BY Name
            HAVING count(DISTINCT Category) != 1)

SELECT count(*) FROM raw.customers
                WHERE try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
                   OR try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
                   OR NOT isfinite(try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE))
                   OR NOT isfinite(try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE))
                   OR try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
                   OR try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180

SELECT count(*) FROM raw.stores
                WHERE try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
                   OR try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
                   OR NOT isfinite(try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE))
                   OR NOT isfinite(try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE))
                   OR try_cast(latitude AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
                   OR try_cast(longitude AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180

SELECT count(*) FROM raw.stores WHERE try_cast(distance AS DOUBLE) IS NULL
            OR NOT isfinite(try_cast(distance AS DOUBLE))

SELECT count(*) FROM (-- Grão: um pedido (id), após validar conflitos na PK da RAW.
-- Preserva orderDate e indica sua precisão; data sem hora não vira meia-noite.
-- Pré-condições: nulos/domínios validados e desvio monetário <= 1e-9.
WITH fonte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM raw.orders
), temporal AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_full_match(orderDate, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z')
                THEN 'second'
            WHEN regexp_full_match(orderDate, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z')
                THEN 'minute'
            WHEN regexp_full_match(orderDate, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                THEN 'date'
            ELSE error('orderDate com formato desconhecido')
        END AS timestamp_precision
    FROM fonte
)
SELECT
    CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id,
    customerId,
    storeId,
    orderDate,
    nItems,
    CAST(total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total,
    CAST(strptime(left(orderDate, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE) AS order_date,
    CASE timestamp_precision
        WHEN 'second' THEN strptime(orderDate, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        WHEN 'minute' THEN strptime(orderDate, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ELSE NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
    END AS order_timestamp,
    timestamp_precision
FROM temporal) f ANTI JOIN (-- Grão: um cliente (id), após validar conflito de chave e coordenadas.
WITH fonte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM raw.customers
)
SELECT
    id,
    CAST(latitude AS DOUBLE) AS latitude,
    CAST(longitude AS DOUBLE) AS longitude
FROM fonte) p ON f.customerId=p.id

        ELSE NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ

-- Zipcode permanece texto. Distance é medida sem unidade comprovada.
WITH fonte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM raw.stores
)
SELECT

    zipcode,
    state_abbr,

SELECT count(*) FROM (-- Grão: uma ocorrência de SKU no pedido, sem PK natural de linha.
-- Não aplicar DISTINCT: linhas iguais representam unidades legítimas.
SELECT
    SKU,
    CAST(orderID AS VARCHAR) AS orderID
FROM raw.order_items) f ANTI JOIN (-- Grão: um SKU, após validar conflitos da PK e formato monetário na RAW.
-- Launch aceita somente ISO exato ou ISO com uma vírgula terminal.
WITH fonte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM raw.products
), lancamento AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_full_match(Launch, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                THEN Launch
            WHEN regexp_full_match(Launch, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2},')
                THEN left(Launch, 10)
            ELSE error('Launch com formato desconhecido')
        END AS launch_normalizado
    FROM fonte
)
SELECT
    SKU,
    Name,
    CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Price,
    Category,
    Size,
    Ingredients,
    CAST(strptime(launch_normalizado, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE) AS Launch
FROM lancamento) p ON f.SKU=p.SKU

-- Não aplicar DISTINCT: linhas iguais representam unidades legítimas.
SELECT
    SKU,
    CAST(orderID AS VARCHAR) AS orderID
FROM raw.order_items), p AS (-- Grão: um SKU, após validar conflitos da PK e formato monetário na RAW.
-- Launch aceita somente ISO exato ou ISO com uma vírgula terminal.
WITH fonte AS (

    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_full_match(Launch, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                THEN Launch
            WHEN regexp_full_match(Launch, '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2},')

    CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Price,
    Category,
    Size,
    Ingredients,
    CAST(strptime(launch_normalizado, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE) AS Launch
FROM lancamento), valores AS (SELECT i.orderID, count(*) AS unidades, sum(p.Price) AS receita FROM i JOIN p ON i.SKU=p.SKU GROUP BY i.orderID) 
            SELECT count(*) FROM o LEFT JOIN valores v ON o.id=v.orderID
            WHERE o.nItems IS DISTINCT FROM v.unidades
               OR o.total IS DISTINCT FROM v.receita
